sortieLines.line: Smacking, from the treeline. Rhythmic. Getting closer.
Smacking, from the treeline. Rhythmic. Getting closer.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
The Eater stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
Not enough fighters to send — a sortie needs at least two besides you, and the bench is bare. (Endure it, or call for help.)

🌙 Night. The lingering The Eater gorges at the treeline — 1,440 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
